title: Sensor fault at Node B
description: Node B's voltage sensor saturates (reports an impossible value with sensor_status SATURATED and data_valid false) for 20 s, then recovers.
what_to_look_for: Node B turns grey 'Invalid data'. Its last VALID voltage is shown with its age; the saturated value is NOT shown as a reading.
One SENSOR_FAULT event, closed when the sensor recovers.
